title: Gpt 6 Astra !
author: IntelligentOne5923
selftext: Hey so we all know that gpt 6 astra has just landed and i saw thousands of videos generating games from it which looks so so better and the art does not look "ai generated " so I also thought to give it a try , i told it to build the game assets in 3r using blender but it just could not even after giving it very detailed and better prompts. so can anyone tell what am I missing here , how are you guys able to generate so good assets ?

comments.author: Snoo-29395
comments.body:
A game can't be made in a single prompt, it will give you a slop.

Start with an idea, really small, and build it piece by piece

comments.author: _HoundOfJustice
comments.body: Its often using premade assets or self made assets and puts them into scenes so those assets are not even AI generated. I still wait for access to Astra but i dont think i want it to make the assets for me while i sit back. I still prefer do the stuff myself.

replies.author: Initial-Theme-462
replies.body: In some of the demonstrations on YT they said that astra made the assets itself. I.e. the sims city demonstration

replies.author: _HoundOfJustice
replies.body: Thats possible, i meant that some other cases are people letting AI put premade or self made assets into scenes. What can be done as well is use AI step by step inside of Blender, Maya etc. which i want to test as well. So not just letting AI do it all at once and without references.

replies.author: Vivid-Snow-2089
replies.body:
it needs computer use to use blender, and it has to spend a lot of time on each asset and needs your help sometimes

its a lot better with procedural and voxel stuff, had it generate entire towns, tools, equipment, characters etc out of 1/16th meter voxel ala vintage story

comments.author: YKLKTMA
comments.body: Learn something other than prompting, you can't make a decent game that way

comments.author: Nasilbitatbirakti
comments.body: Download premade characters and put them in a premade 3D environment. It's gonna look and work much better than those videos claiming to be "made by astra working for 24 hours" and it's not even gonna take you 24 minutes.

comments.author: CCB0x45
comments.body: Its trained on common types of games so it does better if its cloning a game vs trying to get it to go out of the box(like all models but this is one is better at doing it). Its still a very capable model though.

comments.author: doudou262
comments.body: If it doesn't work with one shot prompt, start with a simpler one and then slowly iterate from there. It's actually the same process a real artist takes. Always start with a small first step.
